g.title: note
g.text: Arrows summarize selected calls/continuations; dotted/dashed edges are optional or asynchronous.
Grouping wrappers / inline macros keeps this finite: no claim of every transitive helper on all states/drivers.
IPv4 local TCP uses PREROUTING/INPUT or OUTPUT/POSTROUTING, never FORWARD (see overview for all five chains).
Native/generic XDP are alternatives; BPF attachments/config/modules may be absent.
All hook / filter stages may drop, queue or redirect; not all branches return to this diagram.
Excluded from detailed function expansion: bridge, IPv6, XFRM, tunnels, hardware offload, full TCP errors/states.
